The avant-garde [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Musician/Legends|composer]] [[Wurokkk]] wrote a [[Music/Legends|musical]] '''piece''' for the touring [[Smazzo/Legends|smazzo]] [[percussion]] [[Band/Legends|group]] [[Shluur]] as an experiment meant to subliminally encourage aggression in members of the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]]. The experiment proved successful when some Bith began behaving erratically, even violently, a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] after attending performances.

==Description==
The [[Music/Legends|musical]] piece, composed for a [[Smazzo/Legends|smazzo]] [[percussion]] [[Band/Legends|ensemble]],<ref name="blog" /> used vibrations based on [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] biorhythms and [[Brain/Legends|brainwave]] patterns to incite aggressive behavior in members of that [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="GATORW" />

==History==
[[File:PurghomMusicalPerformanceHall-GatORW.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Wurokkk's piece was performed in the Purghom Musical Performance Hall in the city of Weogar on Clak'dor VII.]]
The piece was composed by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wurokkk]], a dangerously avant-garde<ref name="GATORW" /> [[Musician/Legends|arranger]]<ref name="blog" /> for the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] touring<ref name="GATORW" /> smazzo group [[Shluur]].<ref name="blog" /> Created as an experiment, the piece was performed during a two-[[Standard week/Legends|week]] series of sold-out performances by Shluur in the [[Purghom Musical Performance Hall]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]].<ref name="GATORW" />

The intent of the experiment was to cause violent behavior in members of Clak'dor VII's native Bith species. The experiment succeeded when, after a week of performances, some Bith who had attended the Shluur concerts began shouting and damaging property, with one even throwing a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] at another.<ref name="GATORW" /> The violence eventually grew into riots that almost leveled the planetary [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Weogar/Legends|Weogar]].<ref name="blog" />

{{RPGseed}}
The resulting aggression from the Bith caused their shocked [[Government Assembly|government]] to investigate Wurokkk. After it was discovered that every Bith showing aggression had attended multiple Shluur concerts, the Bith government had the Wookiee,<ref name="GATORW" /> along with the entire band,<ref name="blog" /> escorted off-planet.<ref name="GATORW" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Wurokkk's musical piece was introduced in "Beat of a Different Drum," an adventure hook presented in the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', which was published in [[March]] [[2004]] by [[Wizards of the Coast]]. In the scenario, players take on the role of investigating the violence caused by the musical piece and escorting Wurokkk off-planet.<ref name="GATORW" />
